title: Nobody hired a director or writer for this 30-second film

A 30-second AI film that made professional screenwriters look slow
Nobody hired a director or writer for this 30-second film
The 30-second AI short that people keep forwarding to their film friends
caption:
An AI made a 30-second short film that does what most Hollywood productions take two hours to attempt: a complete story arc, real emotional pull, and zero crew.

No camera, no actors, no budget. The whole thing came from a prompt. Story, visuals, pacing, all generated from scratch by one person with AI video tools.

A single afternoon of work now competes with a full production. The gap between an idea and a finished film keeps shrinking.
